lore_summary: A creature of the Iron Dominion, aligned with Synthetic energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Iron Dominion. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Synthetic tamers are called Engineers. Bond is formed through utility — the tamer must craft an item using the monster's unique material output.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Boiler Knight Apprentice
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Boiler Knight Apprentice. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Iron Dominion. Boiler Knight Apprentices in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Boiler Knight Apprentice
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Synthetic — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Iron Dominion. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Boiler Knight Apprentice
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Boiler Knight Apprentice bears the aesthetic of Iron Dominion — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Synthetic crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Iron Dominion. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  intention becomes leverage. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Boiler Knight Apprentice
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the War Machine Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Iron Dominion, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Boiler Knight Apprentice — War Machine Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the War Machine Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Boiler Knight Apprentice is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Iron Dominion. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Boiler Knight Apprentice the Last
star_6.appearance: Boiler Knight Apprentice now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Boiler Knight Apprentices have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Foundry Master Key

star_7.name: Origin Boiler Knight Apprentice
star_7.appearance: The final form. Boiler Knight Apprentice stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Boiler Knight Apprentice is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Grand Forge" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Iron Dominion. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Steam Golem Junior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Steam Golem Junior bears the aesthetic of Iron Dominion — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Synthetic crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Iron Dominion. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  intention becomes leverage. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Steam Golem Junior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the War Machine Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Iron Dominion, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Steam Golem Junior — War Machine Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the War Machine Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Steam Golem Junior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Iron Dominion. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Steam Golem Junior the Revered
star_6.appearance: Steam Golem Junior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Steam Golem Juniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Foundry Master Key

lore_summary: A creature of the Iron Dominion, aligned with Synthetic energy. Known among tamers as a Warborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Iron Dominion. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Synthetic tamers are called Engineers. Bond is formed through utility — the tamer must craft an item using the monster's unique material output.

base_chain.name: Seed Piston Berserker
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Piston Berserker. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Iron Dominion. Piston Berserkers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Piston Berserker
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Synthetic — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Iron Dominion. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Piston Berserker
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Piston Berserker bears the aesthetic of Iron Dominion — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Synthetic crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Iron Dominion. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Cogswain Master is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Cogswain Master
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Cogswain Masters begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Cogswain Master
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Cogswain Masters are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Cogswain Master
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_5.name: Cogswain Grand Master — War Machine Champion
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Cogswain Grand Masters are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: Cogswain Grand Master the Feared
star_6.appearance: Cogswain Grand Master defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Cogswain Grand Masters have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: Final Cogswain Grand Master
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Cogswain Grand Master is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Cogswain Grand Master is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_8.name: Cogswain Grand Master: Eternal Throne
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Cogswain Grand Master at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Cogswain Grand Master has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Newborn Gear Wolf Pack
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Gear Wolf Pack. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Gear Wolf Pack is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: First-Form Gear Wolf Pack
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Gear Wolf Packs begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Gear Wolf Pack
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Gear Wolf Packs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Ascendant Gear Wolf Pack
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_5.name: Piston Bear Minor — War Machine Warlord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Piston Bear Minors are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_6.name: Piston Bear Minor the Absolute
star_6.appearance: Piston Bear Minor defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Piston Bear Minors have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_7.name: Origin Piston Bear Minor
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Piston Bear Minor is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Piston Bear Minor is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_8.name: Piston Bear Minor: The Living Myth
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Piston Bear Minor at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Piston Bear Minor has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Young Piston Bear Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Piston Bear Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Piston Bear Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Kindling Piston Bear Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Piston Bear Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Iron Sovereign path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Piston Bear Iron Titans are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_6.name: Piston Bear Iron Titan the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Piston Bear Iron Titan defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Piston Bear Iron Titans have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: World-Ender Piston Bear Iron Titan
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Piston Bear Iron Titan is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Piston Bear Iron Titan is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_8.name: Piston Bear Iron Titan: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Piston Bear Iron Titan at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Piston Bear Iron Titan has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Bud Piston Bear Iron Titan
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Piston Bear Iron Titan. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Piston Bear Iron Titan is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Nascent Piston Bear Iron Titan
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Piston Bear Iron Titans begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Piston Bear Iron Titan
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Piston Bear Iron Titans are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Marked Piston Bear Iron Titan
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Copper Serpent Minors have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_7.name: Final Copper Serpent Minor
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Copper Serpent Minor is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Copper Serpent Minor is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_8.name: Copper Serpent Minor: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Copper Serpent Minor at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Copper Serpent Minor has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Fledgling Copper Serpent Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Copper Serpent Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Copper Serpent Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Awakened Copper Serpent Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Copper Serpent Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Copper Serpent Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Copper Serpent Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Marked Copper Serpent Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Newborn Iron Moth Swarm
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Iron Moth Swarm. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Iron Moth Swarm is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Kindling Iron Moth Swarm
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Iron Moth Swarms begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Iron Moth Swarm
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Iron Moth Swarms are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ascendant Iron Moth Swarm
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Brass Turtle Shells begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Brass Turtle Shell
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Brass Turtle Shells are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Hallowed Brass Turtle Shell
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_5.name: Brass Turtle Ancient — War Machine Lord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Brass Turtle Ancients are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_6.name: Brass Turtle Ancient the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Brass Turtle Ancient defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Brass Turtle Ancients have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_7.name: Last Brass Turtle Ancient
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Brass Turtle Ancient is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Brass Turtle Ancient is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_8.name: Brass Turtle Ancient: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Brass Turtle Ancient at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Brass Turtle Ancient has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Newborn Steam Hound Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Steam Hound Alpha. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Steam Hound Alpha is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Awakened Steam Hound Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Steam Hound Alphas begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Steam Hound Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Steam Hound Alphas are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Branded Steam Hound Alpha
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Awakened Iron Pegasus Foal

base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_8.name: Clockwork Unicorn: Axis of the Age

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Clockwork Unicorn has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Bud Clockwork Unicorn
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Clockwork Unicorn. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Clockwork Unicorn is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: First-Form Clockwork Unicorn
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Clockwork Unicorns begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Clockwork Unicorn
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Clockwork Unicorns are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Chosen Clockwork Unicorn
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Nascent Steam Centaur Archer

base_chain.lore: Awakened Steam Centaur Archers begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Automaton Generals have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_7.name: Absolute Automaton General
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Automaton General is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Automaton General is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

star_8.name: Automaton General: Zero-Origin
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Automaton General at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Automaton General has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Newborn Automaton General
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Automaton General. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Automaton General is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Emerging Automaton General
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Automaton Generals begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Automaton General
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Automaton Generals are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Branded Automaton General
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Young Mech Sentinel Prime

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Mech Sentinel Prime is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Kindling Mech Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Mech Sentinel Primes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Mech Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Mech Sentinel Primes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Smelter Wraith Elder has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Fledgling Smelter Wraith Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Smelter Wraith Elder. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Smelter Wraith Elder is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Kindling Smelter Wraith Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Smelter Wraith Elders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Smelter Wraith Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Smelter Wraith Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Smelter Wraith Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_5.name: Smelter Wraith Sovereign — War Machine Champion
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Smelter Wraith Sovereigns are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_6.name: Smelter Wraith Sovereign of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Smelter Wraith Sovereign defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Smelter Wraith Sovereigns have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Chimney Specter Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Chimney Specter Elders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Chimney Specter Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Chimney Specter Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.

base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Slag Elemental Greaters are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Branded Slag Elemental Greater
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_5.name: Slag Elemental Prime — War Machine Hegemon
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Slag Elemental Primes are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_6.name: Slag Elemental Prime the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Slag Elemental Prime defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Slag Elemental Primes have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_7.name: World-Ender Slag Elemental Prime

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_7.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Slag Elemental Prime has never been fully documented. base_chain.name: Rising Pressure Elemental Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Pressure Elemental Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: First-Form Wrench Imp Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Wrench Imp Elders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Wrench Imp Elder

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Wrench Imp Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Hallowed Wrench Imp Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Piston Rat Packs have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_7.name: Apex Piston Rat Pack
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Piston Rat Pack is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_7.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Piston Rat Pack at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Piston Rat Pack has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. star_8.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat
