base_chain.name: Spawn Piston Rat Pack
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Piston Rat Pack. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Piston Rat Pack is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Stirring Piston Rat Pack
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Piston Rat Packs begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Piston Rat Pack
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Piston Rat Packs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Hallowed Piston Rat Pack
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Industry Magnate
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Industry Magnates begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Seed Airship Pirate Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Airship Pirate Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Airship Pirate Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Rising Airship Pirate Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Airship Pirate Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Airship Pirate Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Airship Pirate Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Branded Airship Pirate Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Rising Coal Baron Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.name: Coal Baron Elder

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Coal Baron Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.

base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_5.name: Iron Titan Champion — War Machine Hegemon
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Iron Titan Champions are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_6.name: Iron Titan Champion the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Iron Titan Champion defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Iron Titan Champions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_7.name: World-Ender Iron Titan Champion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Iron Titan Champion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Iron Titan Champion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_8.name: Iron Titan Champion: First and Last
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Iron Titan Champion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Iron Titan Champion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Spawn Mechagnome Engineer

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Rising Mechagnome Engineer
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Mechagnome Engineers begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Mechagnome Engineer

base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Gnomish Automaton Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: First-Form Gnomish Automaton Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Gnomish Automaton Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Gnomish Automaton Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Gnomish Automaton Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Ascendant Gnomish Automaton Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_5.name: Gnomish Automaton Alpha — War Machine Champion
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Gnomish Automaton Alphas are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: Gnomish Automaton Alpha the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Gnomish Automaton Alpha defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Gnomish Automaton Alphas have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: Final Gnomish Automaton Alpha
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Gnomish Automaton Alpha is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Gnomish Automaton Alpha is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Gnomish Automaton Alpha has never been fully documented. base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Dwarven Warmachine Titan is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: First-Form Dwarven Warmachine Titan
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dwarven Warmachine Titans begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Dwarven Warmachine Titan
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Dwarven Warmachine Titans are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Crowned Dwarven Warmachine Titan
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_5.name: Iron Golem Minor — War Machine Champion
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Iron Golem Minors are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_6.name: Iron Golem Minor the Feared
star_6.appearance: Iron Golem Minor defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Iron Golem Minors have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_7.name: Last Iron Golem Minor
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Iron Golem Minor is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Iron Golem Minor is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_8.name: Iron Golem Minor: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Iron Golem Minor at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Iron Golem Minor has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

star_8.name: Warforged Commander: Zero-Origin
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Warforged Commander at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Warforged Commander has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_5.name: Warforged Commander — Iron Sovereign Lord

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Iron Sovereign path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Warforged Commanders are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Stirring Warforged Commander
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Warforged Commanders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Warforged Commander
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Warforged Commanders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Exalted Warforged Commander
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Iron Sovereign path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Arcane Construct Minors are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_6.name: Arcane Construct Minor Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Arcane Construct Minor defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Arcane Construct Minors have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_7.name: Primordial Arcane Construct Minor
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Arcane Construct Minor is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Arcane Construct Minor is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_8.name: Arcane Construct Minor: Zero-Origin
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Arcane Construct Minor at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Arcane Construct Minor has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Young Arcane Construct Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Arcane Construct Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Arcane Construct Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Stirring Arcane Construct Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Arcane Construct Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Arcane Construct Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Arcane Construct Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Crowned Arcane Construct Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Seed Stone Golem Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Stone Golem Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Stone Golem Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: First-Form Stone Golem Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Stone Golem Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Stone Golem Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Stone Golem Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Forsaken Stone Golem Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Newborn Metal Slime Minor

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Kindling Metal Slime Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Metal Slime Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Metal Slime Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Metal Slime Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Forsaken Metal Slime Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Wisp Metal Slime King

base_chain.name: Nascent Metal Slime King

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Siege Engine Champions begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Siege Engine Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Siege Engine Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Ascendant Siege Engine Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_5.name: Siege Engine Titan — War Machine Baron
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Siege Engine Titans are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_6.name: Siege Engine Titan the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Siege Engine Titan defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Siege Engine Titans have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_7.name: Eternal Siege Engine Titan
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Siege Engine Titan is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Siege Engine Titan is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_8.name: Siege Engine Titan: God-Form
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Siege Engine Titan at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Siege Engine Titan has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Newborn Battlemech Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Battlemech Champion. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Battlemech Champion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Rising Battlemech Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Battlemech Champions begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Battlemech Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Battlemech Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Forsaken Battlemech Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_5.name: War Colossus Champion — War Machine Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class War Colossus Champions are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_6.name: War Colossus Champion Incarnate
star_6.appearance: War Colossus Champion defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent War Colossus Champions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_7.name: Primordial War Colossus Champion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of War Colossus Champion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of War Colossus Champion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_8.name: War Colossus Champion: The Living Myth
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. War Colossus Champion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of War Colossus Champion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.name: Nascent Clockwork Phoenix Minor

base_chain.name: Clockwork Phoenix Minor

base_chain.name: Newborn Gear Hydra Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Gear Hydra Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Stirring Gear Hydra Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Gear Hydra Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Gear Hydra Minor

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Gear Hydra Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Forsaken Gear Hydra Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Brass Griffin Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Awakened Brass Griffin Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Brass Griffin Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Brass Griffin Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Brass Griffin Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Marked Brass Griffin Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_5.name: Brass Griffin Champion — War Machine Hegemon
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Brass Griffin Champions are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_6.name: Brass Griffin Champion the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Brass Griffin Champion defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Brass Griffin Champions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

star_7.name: World-Ender Brass Griffin Champion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Brass Griffin Champion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Brass Griffin Champion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_8.name: Brass Griffin Champion: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Brass Griffin Champion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Brass Griffin Champion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Clockwork Mimic Elders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Clockwork Mimic Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Clockwork Mimic Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Ascendant Clockwork Mimic Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_5.name: Gear Mimic Master — War Machine Warlord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Gear Mimic Masters are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_6.name: Gear Mimic Master the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Gear Mimic Master defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Gear Mimic Masters have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_7.name: Origin Gear Mimic Master
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Gear Mimic Master is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Gear Mimic Master is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_8.name: Gear Mimic Master: The Living Myth
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Gear Mimic Master at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Gear Mimic Master has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Rising Factory Sentinel Champion

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Factory Sentinel Champion

base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Spawn Cogwork Assassin Shadow
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Cogwork Assassin Shadow. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Cogwork Assassin Shadow is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Emerging Cogwork Assassin Shadow
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Cogwork Assassin Shadows begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Cogwork Assassin Shadow
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Cogwork Assassin Shadows are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Cogwork Assassin Shadow
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Echo Iron Lich Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Iron Lich Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Iron Lich Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Emerging Iron Lich Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Iron Lich Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Iron Lich Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Iron Lich Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Hallowed Iron Lich Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Factory Wraith Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Factory Wraith Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Factory Wraith Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Crowned Factory Wraith Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

star_5.name: Factory Wraith Elder — War Machine Baron
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Factory Wraith Elders are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_6.name: Factory Wraith Elder the Feared
star_6.appearance: Factory Wraith Elder defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Factory Wraith Elders have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_7.name: World-Ender Factory Wraith Elder
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Factory Wraith Elder is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Factory Wraith Elder is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_8.name: Factory Wraith Elder: First and Last
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Factory Wraith Elder at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Factory Wraith Elder has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost
