base_chain.name: Fledgling Omega Prototype
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Omega Prototype. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Omega Prototype is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Kindling Omega Prototype
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Omega Prototypes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Omega Prototype
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Omega Prototypes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Hallowed Omega Prototype
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Chaos Machine Champion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: First-Form Chaos Machine Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Chaos Machine Champions begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Chaos Machine Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Chaos Machine Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Branded Chaos Machine Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Juggernaut Iron Alphas are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Ascendant Juggernaut Iron Alpha
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_5.name: Juggernaut Iron Sovereign — War Machine Warlord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Juggernaut Iron Sovereigns are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_6.name: Juggernaut Iron Sovereign the Unbroken
star_6.appearance: Juggernaut Iron Sovereign defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Juggernaut Iron Sovereigns have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_7.name: Primordial Juggernaut Iron Sovereign
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Juggernaut Iron Sovereign is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Juggernaut Iron Sovereign is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_8.name: Juggernaut Iron Sovereign: Zero-Origin
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Juggernaut Iron Sovereign at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Juggernaut Iron Sovereign has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Emerging Necron Warrior Basic
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Necron Warrior Basics begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Necron Warrior Basic
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Necron Warrior Basics are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Necron Lords have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_7.name: Absolute Necron Lord
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Necron Lord is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Necron Lord is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_8.name: Necron Lord: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Necron Lord at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Necron Lord has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Young Necron Lord
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Necron Lord. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Necron Lord is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Nascent Necron Lord
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Necron Lords begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Necron Lord
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Necron Lords are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Crowned Necron Lord
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: Emerging Necron Monolith
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Necron Monoliths begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Necron Monolith
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Necron Monoliths are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Rising Vindicator Siege Minor

base_chain.lore: Awakened Vindicator Siege Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Vindicator Siege Minor

base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Bud Dreadnought Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Dreadnought Ancient. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Awakened Dreadnought Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Dreadnought Ancients begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Dreadnought Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Dreadnought Ancients are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Marked Dreadnought Ancient
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.name: Lesser Hellbrute Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Hellbrute Elder. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Hellbrute Elder is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Awakened Hellbrute Elder
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Hellbrute Elders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Hellbrute Elder
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Hellbrute Elders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Chosen Hellbrute Elder
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Nascent Mechanicum Omnissiah
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Mechanicum Omnissiahs begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Mechanicum Omnissiah
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Mechanicum Omnissiahs are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Iron Sovereign path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Skitarii Vanguards are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

star_6.name: Skitarii Vanguard the Feared
star_6.appearance: Skitarii Vanguard defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Skitarii Vanguards have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

star_7.name: Primordial Skitarii Vanguard
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Skitarii Vanguard is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Skitarii Vanguard is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_8.name: Skitarii Vanguard: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Skitarii Vanguard at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Skitarii Vanguard has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Newborn Skitarii Vanguard
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Skitarii Vanguard. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Skitarii Vanguard is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Skitarii Vanguard
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Skitarii Vanguards begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Skitarii Vanguard
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Skitarii Vanguards are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ascendant Skitarii Vanguard
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Kastelan Datasmiths have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_7.name: Apex Kastelan Datasmith
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Kastelan Datasmith is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Kastelan Datasmith is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_8.name: Kastelan Datasmith: The Undying
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Kastelan Datasmith at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Kastelan Datasmith has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Young Kastelan Datasmith
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Kastelan Datasmith. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Kastelan Datasmith is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Stirring Kastelan Datasmith
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Kastelan Datasmiths begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Kastelan Datasmith
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Kastelan Datasmiths are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ascendant Kastelan Datasmith
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Wisp Serberys Raider
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Serberys Raider. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Serberys Raider is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: First-Form Serberys Raider
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Serberys Raiders begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Serberys Raider
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Serberys Raiders are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Forsaken Serberys Raider
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Echo Archaeopter Fusilave

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Archaeopter Fusilave is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.

base_chain.name: Emerging Archaeopter Fusilave
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Archaeopter Fusilaves begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Archaeopter Fusilave
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Archaeopter Fusilaves are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Hallowed Archaeopter Fusilave
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: Emerging Battle Automata Thanatar
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Battle Automata Thanatars begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Battle Automata Thanatar

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Battle Automata Thanatars are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.

base_chain.name: Wisp Mobile Suit Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Mobile Suit Champion. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Mobile Suit Champion is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Kindling Mobile Suit Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Mobile Suit Champions begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Mobile Suit Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Mobile Suit Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.name: Ascendant Mobile Suit Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Stirring Mobile Suit Legend

base_chain.name: Mobile Suit Legend

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Jaeger Scouts have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

star_7.name: Last Jaeger Scout
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Jaeger Scout is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Jaeger Scout is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_8.name: Jaeger Scout: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Jaeger Scout at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Jaeger Scout has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Pup Jaeger Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Jaeger Scout. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Jaeger Scout is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Jaeger Scout
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Jaeger Scouts begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Jaeger Scout
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Jaeger Scouts are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Ascendant Jaeger Scout
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Bud Zoid Wolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Zoid Wolf Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Zoid Wolf Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Awakened Zoid Wolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Zoid Wolf Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Zoid Wolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Zoid Wolf Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Hallowed Zoid Wolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Mechwarrior Champion

base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Mechwarrior Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.

base_chain.name: Newborn Megazord Supreme
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Megazord Supreme. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Megazord Supreme is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Stirring Megazord Supreme
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Megazord Supremes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Megazord Supreme
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Megazord Supremes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Branded Megazord Supreme
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Awakened Autobot Optimus
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Autobot Optimuss begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Autobot Optimus
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Autobot Optimuss are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: Exalted Autobot Optimus
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the Iron Sovereign path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Evangelion Tabriss are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. star_5.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_6.name: Evangelion Tabris the True
star_6.appearance: Evangelion Tabris defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Evangelion Tabriss have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

star_7.name: Final Evangelion Tabris
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Evangelion Tabris is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Evangelion Tabris is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_8.name: Evangelion Tabris: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Evangelion Tabris at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Evangelion Tabris has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Bud Evangelion Tabris
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Evangelion Tabris. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Evangelion Tabris is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

base_chain.name: First-Form Evangelion Tabris
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Evangelion Tabriss begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Evangelion Tabris
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Evangelion Tabriss are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Chosen Evangelion Tabris
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.

star_6.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_7.name: Final Armored Core Scout
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Armored Core Scout is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_7.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Armored Core Scout has never been fully documented. base_chain.name: Bud Armored Core Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Armored Core Scout. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Armored Core Scout is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Nascent Armored Core Scout
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Armored Core Scouts begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: Armored Core Scout
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Armored Core Scouts are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Hallowed Armored Core Scout
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP
