base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened T-1000 Polys begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: T-1000 Poly
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class T-1000 Polys are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

base_chain.name: Forsaken T-1000 Poly
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_5.name: T-X Advanced — War Machine Lord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class T-X Advanceds are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_6.name: T-X Advanced the Ancient
star_6.appearance: T-X Advanced defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent T-X Advanceds have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.name: Last T-X Advanced
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of T-X Advanced is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of T-X Advanced is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

star_8.name: T-X Advanced: Eternal Throne
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. T-X Advanced at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of T-X Advanced has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Bud RoboCop Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of RoboCop Minor. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of RoboCop Minor is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Emerging RoboCop Minor
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened RoboCop Minors begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Myth Bond — gains a stat copy of the tamer's highest active stat

base_chain.name: RoboCop Minor
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class RoboCop Minors are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Star Blessing — gains +10% to all stats under night/dark conditions

base_chain.name: Hallowed RoboCop Minor
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

star_5.name: Skynet Node Champion — War Machine Lord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Skynet Node Champions are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_6.name: Skynet Node Champion the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Skynet Node Champion defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Skynet Node Champions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

star_7.name: Last Skynet Node Champion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Skynet Node Champion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Skynet Node Champion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

star_8.name: Skynet Node Champion: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Skynet Node Champion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Skynet Node Champion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_6.name: HAL 9000 Eye the Eternal
star_6.appearance: HAL 9000 Eye defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent HAL 9000 Eyes have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_7.name: Last HAL 9000 Eye
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of HAL 9000 Eye is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.

star_7.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

star_8.name: HAL 9000 Eye: World-Soul
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. HAL 9000 Eye at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of HAL 9000 Eye has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Void Step — 15% chance to phase through any attack

base_chain.name: Lesser HAL 9000 Eye
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of HAL 9000 Eye. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of HAL 9000 Eye is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Nascent HAL 9000 Eye
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened HAL 9000 Eyes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: HAL 9000 Eye
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class HAL 9000 Eyes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Exalted HAL 9000 Eye
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.

base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.

base_chain.name: First-Form Data Android Champion
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Data Android Champions begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Tidal Flow — HP regenerates 2% per turn

base_chain.name: Data Android Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Data Android Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Ultron Seeds begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

base_chain.name: Ultron Seed
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Ultron Seeds are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Exalted Ultron Seed
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_5.name: Ultron Champion — War Machine Lord
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Ultron Champions are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

star_6.name: Ultron Champion the True
star_6.appearance: Ultron Champion defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Ultron Champions have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

star_7.name: Final Ultron Champion
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Ultron Champion is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Ultron Champion is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Hive Mind — shares 10% of own HP/ATK with adjacent allies

star_8.name: Ultron Champion: Axis of the Age
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Ultron Champion at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Ultron Champion has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Spawn Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Sentinel Prime. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Sentinel Prime is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

base_chain.name: First-Form Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Sentinel Primes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Dragon Scales — immune to burn, poison, and frost

base_chain.name: Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Sentinel Primes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Pack Hunter — +12% ATK per ally of same realm (max +48%)

base_chain.name: Hallowed Sentinel Prime
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Code Geass Knightmare is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_8.name: Code Geass Knightmare: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Code Geass Knightmare at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Code Geass Knightmare has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Newborn Code Geass Knightmare
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Code Geass Knightmare. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Code Geass Knightmare is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Emerging Code Geass Knightmare
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Code Geass Knightmares begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Code Geass Knightmare
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Code Geass Knightmares are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Forsaken Code Geass Knightmare
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.

base_chain.name: Bud Heavy Object Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Heavy Object Elite. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Heavy Object Elite is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Forge Tempered — +20% DEF against physical attacks

base_chain.name: Awakened Heavy Object Elite
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Heavy Object Elites begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Chaos Mutation — randomly gains a different buff each battle

base_chain.name: Heavy Object Elite
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Heavy Object Elites are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Spectral Drift — 25% evasion rate against non-magical attacks

base_chain.name: Hallowed Heavy Object Elite
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Leviathan Blood — immune to drowning/suffocation effects

base_chain.name: Kindling Full Metal Panic Lambda
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.

base_chain.name: Full Metal Panic Lambda

base_chain.name: Gurren Lagann Champion
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class Gurren Lagann Champions are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — immune to all crowd-control effects

base_chain.name: Marked Gurren Lagann Champion
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Death's Bargain — revives once per battle at 20% HP

star_5.name: Gurren Lagann Arc — War Machine Archon
star_5.appearance: The War Machine path has crystallized this creature's identity. Its form is now iconic and unmistakable — tamers know that facing a Sovereign-class entity means the rules of engagement have changed entirely.
star_5.personality: Commands respect effortlessly. Has developed a personal philosophy shaped by the War Machine path — it will not violate this code regardless of the tamer's instructions.
star_5.lore: Sovereign-class Gurren Lagann Arcs are landmarks. Iron Dominion merchants route supply lines around their territories; settlement leaders consult their behavior for weather and war omens. A tamer who bonds with one is marked for life — literally, in some traditions, through ritual scarification upon the bond's formation.
star_5.passive: Berserker Soul — ATK rises 3% for each 1% HP lost

star_6.name: Gurren Lagann Arc the Absolute
star_6.appearance: Gurren Lagann Arc defies easy classification. Its form flickers between states of matter. It is simultaneously ancient and immediate. Those who look directly at it for more than a few moments report persistent dreams about something they cannot name.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved past the need to prove itself. Communicates rarely but each instance carries significant weight that tamers report as lingering in memory.
star_6.lore: Transcendent Gurren Lagann Arcs have their own entries in the Great Codex — individual entries, not species entries. Each one is named. Each one has a documented history. Scholars have noted that the death of a Transcendent changes the ecology of an entire region for decades.
star_6.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

star_7.name: Apex Gurren Lagann Arc
star_7.appearance: The Apex form of Gurren Lagann Arc is a living landmark. Cartographers note it on maps. Its presence reshapes local weather patterns, draws weaker creatures into orbit, and causes instruments to malfunction.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality has become part of the world's story. Villages name children after it. Scholars write competing interpretations of its behaviors.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Gurren Lagann Arc is achieved only through completing the legendary quest "The Grand Forge". Those who have done so describe the moment of transformation as feeling the world briefly hold its breath. The creature's tamer gains the title of World-Keeper.
star_7.passive: Data Overlock — +25% SPD when HP above 75%

star_8.name: Gurren Lagann Arc: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Gurren Lagann Arc at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Gurren Lagann Arc has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.

base_chain.name: Young World Forge Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of World Forge Prime. Its body is simple — barely touched by the undefined element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of World Forge Prime is found only in the most sheltered corners of Iron Dominion. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: First-Form World Forge Prime
base_chain.appearance: The undefined element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened World Forge Primes begin staking small territory within Iron Dominion. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: World Forge Prime
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Iron Dominion origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of undefined radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Iron Dominion, Champion-class World Forge Primes are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Crowned World Forge Prime
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Iron Dominion-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — War Machine — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the War Machine path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Iron Dominion records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker
